linux:
[Unit]
Description=CodeNomad: start OpenCode at login

[Service]
Type=simple
Environment="PATH=/opt/code:/bin"
ExecStart="/home/u/Code & $$files%%/opencode" "serve" "--service"
Restart=on-abnormal
RestartPreventExitStatus=SIGKILL
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
